facts.text: Dunk must help Ingrid get into Warwick's house and give Warwick the sleeping potion.
facts.possibly_moot: Sir Phidipaldi told Ingrid that Warwick knows about her night visits and is not interested (beat_58), and she left crestfallen (beat_60); Ingrid never released Dunk.

facts.text: Now that Sir Phidipaldi has told her Warwick knows and is not interested, will Ingrid keep secretly visiting Warwick at night, or still expect Dunk's help?
